notes: These are archived research data, not live telemetry.
Per-series dates describe observations, not the build date.
Gaps are retained; no dashboard interpolation or rating curve is applied.
Processed source data have not been independently recalibrated.

sources.evidence: Groundwater/Soap Prov Step 2: Process and correct transducer data.ipynb: sensor depth and stickup in cm; pressure correction kPa × 10.1972; daily median. One NC plot labels metres, but no conversion occurs in the calculation. This export converts the computed centimetres to metres.
Discharge/Dilution/SRS_process_dilution_calc_Q.ipynb explicitly converts L/s to m³/s; source column Q (cms). Source flag is retained; nonzero-flag observations are excluded from default values.

Meteorology/BHR neon_soap.ipynb: NEON DP1.00045.001 tipping bucket, DP1.00046.001 throughfall, DP1.00004.001 pressure. Hourly sums; timestamps shifted from UTC by 8 h. Upstream sum() can replace missing data with zero, and pressure is interpolated.
sources.duplicate_handling: Complementary duplicate hour coalesced after checking for conflicting non-null values.

series.label: SOAP tipping-bucket precipitation
series.aggregation: daily sum of 24 unflagged archived hours
series.time_basis: Fixed UTC−08:00 (PST) as stored upstream; not daylight-saving local time
notes: Archive only; not current rainfall.
Days with fewer than 24 unflagged archived hours are missing.
Upstream hourly resampling may have zero-filled missing subhourly data; daily completeness cannot be certified.
Do not use this archive for water-balance totals without checking the original NEON data.

excluded.reason: Wind-sector subsets contain a flux column without units or aligned quality flags in the CSV; not treated as watershed evapotranspiration.
Export metadata and units require verification before comparison with tower fluxes.
CSV does not establish units and processing provenance; not presented as NEON tower observations.
Raw sensor channels include negative water-content values and lack verified channel-to-depth metadata in this build.
Providence records and gage DEPTH_TO_WATER pseudo-well columns excluded from Soap/Newt groundwater charts.
